reason: Every store-bought green chutney I've ever tasted has a sour vinegar and chemical aftertaste rather than real fresh mint and coriander.
objection: Packaged green chutney always tastes sour and chemical due to preservatives, nothing like authentic homemade chutney.
would_change_my_mind: Tasting a sample first to confirm it actually tastes like fresh dhaniya-pudina without a sour vinegar punch.
